name: The Westin St. Francis San Francisco on Union Square
positioning: Historic landmark hotel on Union Square in downtown San Francisco, welcoming guests since 1904, with classic rooms in the Landmark Building and suites in the Tower Building
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable Union Square base near cable cars and shopping
Guests drawn to San Francisco history and landmark architecture
Couples and groups wanting high-floor suites with city and bay views

facts.text: The hotel is located on Union Square.
Cable cars stop just outside the hotel's doors.
The hotel is within walking distance of Chinatown, North Beach and the Embarcadero.
Union Square, right outside the hotel's doors, offers shopping and dining, including the Macy's West flagship.
The hotel has been a San Francisco landmark since 1904 and has hosted royalty, celebrities and politicians.
The Charles Crocker family built the hotel with a vision of making San Francisco the Paris of the West.
Rooms are in the Landmark Building and residential suites are in the Tower Building.
All rooms offer Heavenly Beds and marble bathrooms.
The lobby has soaring ceilings, cream-and-black marble flooring and chandeliers.
The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio is complimentary for guests and open around the clock.
A Run Concierge leads RunWESTIN guided group runs along the Embarcadero, with views of the bay, Alcatraz Island and the city skyline.
Bourbon Steak features premium cuts, refined seafood and seasonal California ingredients.

highlights.text: Glass-walled elevators run up the exterior wall of the Tower Building.
A two-bedroom corner suite on the 31st floor has views of Alcatraz, the Golden Gate Bridge, the North Bay and East Bay.
Many rooms feature chandeliers, soaring ceilings and decorative moldings that reflect the landmark building.
A two-level Landmark Building suite has carved wood paneling and leaded glass windows that open onto Union Square.
The Chateau Montelena tasting room, for Napa Valley wines, is located within the hotel lobby.

considerations.text: One dog per room is allowed; cats and other pets are not.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes city noise from the busy Union Square area.
